verdicts.reason: A is mostly the original shrunk and stacked into the space. The 'Garden-fresh fizz' headline and the oversized CTA pill run into both decorative circles. The can is shrunk to an icon whose label can't be read. The legal line wraps so 'details.' sits alone on a line, packed against the bottom edge over the circle. B actually rearranges the layout: the logo sits inside the left circle, the can inside the right one, the headline is a clear focal band and the CTA and legal text share a bottom row. Its flaws: the can is still tiny and its label unreadable, the legal text beside the CTA is cramped and competes with it, and the left edges don't quite line up.
